The Contour HTTPProxy API is a Kubernetes Custom Resource Definition that extends the standard Ingress API with advanced routing features including multi-team support, TLS delegation, weighted load balancing, and cross-namespace inclusion of routing configuration. HTTPProxy is Contour's primary ingress configuration resource, managed through the Kubernetes API server.
